Fast-confirmed blocks are passed to the EL by repurposing the `safe` block tag, which today surfaces the latest justified block. We’re noticing now that major RPC providers have backwards compatibility concerns because some of their core users rely on today’s behavior of `safe`. We’re considering a new `fast` tag instead which would return the latest fast-confirmed block while `safe` would continue returning the latest justified block. 

I'd appreciate a few minutes on the next call to bring this up and ask for client feedback if possible.
I would like to give a quick clarification on the devnet-8 slow blocks discussion from last ADCE and the safety of the 200M gas limit
Small bug we found when trying to do a shadowfork with genesis.json format with all ELs https://github.com/eth-clients/mainnet/pull/18
